### ITERATION 1 CONSTRAINTS
[S-Section]: Confine the Subjective section strictly to patient-reported symptoms and statements. Do not include provider observations or clinical interpretations, even if related to patient complaints.
[P-Section]: When detailing follow-up plans, state only the explicitly mentioned purposes. Do not infer or add general medical practices (e.g., 'adjust treatment plan') if not directly stated by the provider.

### ITERATION 2 CONSTRAINTS
[P-Section]: Include only future actions, referrals, or prescriptions explicitly stated by the provider. Do not infer new plan items from discussions about past adherence or general health advice unless explicitly framed as a directive for future action.

### ITERATION 3 CONSTRAINTS
[S-Section]: When detailing the patient's chief complaint and associated symptoms, ensure all stated causes or contributing factors are explicitly reported by the patient. Do not attribute provider observations or clinical findings as patient-reported reasons for their symptoms.
